questions.question: The Indian desert is located towards which direction of the Aravali Hills in India?
In which year was the Partition of Bengal, which divided the province into Eastern and Western regions, implemented?
Which health technology event was held at Pragati Maidan, New Delhi, from February 20 to 22, 2025?
Which of the following was a primary goal of India's First Five-Year Plan (1951-56)?
options: Privatization of major public sector enterprises
Expansion of space and nuclear technology
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'A' (Development of agriculture and irrigation) है।

questions.question: As of April 18, 2025, what was India’s total foreign exchange reserves according to the Reserve Bank of India?
Which of the following statements regarding Directive Principles of State Policy is INCORRECT?
options: These elements are legally and politically acceptable.
These elements explain the socio-economic democracy of the country.
Their nature is positive and states need them.
These are not enforceable by the court.
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'A' (These elements are legally and politically acceptable.) है।

questions.question: Under the Industrial Policy Statement of 1973, which industries were designated as 'core industries'?
options: Cement, iron & steel, electricity, crude oil
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'D' (Cement, iron & steel, electricity, crude oil) है।

questions.question: Under which of the following articles is the provision of participation of workers in management of industry mentioned?
Which of the following bodies was established in 2010 to ensure speedy and effective resolution of disputes related to environmental protection in India?
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'A' (National Green Tribunal) है।

questions.question: What is the total number of new medical seats India plans to add over five years, as per Budget 2025?

Operation Shiv Shakti was launched by the Indian Army primarily to counter what type of activity?
What is the name of the unified digital platform launched by the Government of India to streamline investments in the agriculture sector ?
Liberalisation of the industrial sector in India after 1991 mainly aimed at:
options: Expanding reservation of industries for the public sector
Increasing price controls by the government
Abolishing industrial licensing for most industries
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'D' (Abolishing industrial licensing for most industries) है।

questions.question: Who among the following was the Chairman of the National Commission on urbanisation appointed in 1985-1988 in India?
How much quantity of 2 N NaCl is required to make 100 ml of 0.5 N solution?
Who among the following is responsible for overseeing the administration of the Scheduled areas in a state in India?
Which of the following is not a characteristic of the Eastern coastal plain?
options: The eastern coastal plain is broader than the western coastal plain
The eastern coastal plain is an example of an emergent coast
The eastern coastal plains have well-developed river deltas
The eastern coastal plain of India is predominantly rocky
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'D' (The eastern coastal plain of India is predominantly rocky) है।
